# jz

> Compile the numeric JavaScript you already test to lean GC-free WASM — same source, no rewrite, type annotations, or runtime.

JZ compiles a distilled JavaScript subset, Crockford's "good parts", into native-grade WASM. Valid JZ is valid JS: the same source runs as plain JS or compiles without rewrite to .wasm – sandboxed, portable, memory-safe.

## Docs

- [README](https://jz.js.org/README.md): install, usage, the supported subset, FAQ
- [Stability contract](https://jz.js.org/STABILITY.md): what stays fixed across versions
- [Contributing](https://jz.js.org/CONTRIBUTING.md): architecture, tests, performance invariants

## Try

- [REPL](https://jz.js.org/repl/): compile and run in the browser
- [Examples](https://jz.js.org/examples/): live demos compiled from plain JS
- [Benchmarks](https://jz.js.org/bench/): jz against V8, Porffor, AssemblyScript and native
